findings.title: Add's doc comment has a typo
findings.detail: alpha/alpha.go: the doc comment above Add reads "a plus b"; it should read "a + b".

findings.title: Greet does not guard against an empty name
findings.detail: beta/beta.go: Greet renders "Hello, ." when name is empty; it should fall back to a generic greeting.

summary: Round 1 review: one mechanical doc-comment typo and one intent gap in Greet's empty-name handling.
